plan: Turn 1: attack with the partner while Rillaboom uses Fake Out or Volcarona sets Tailwind. Protect the member the opponent wants to hit.
Middle: use Rage Powder to take single-target hits away from Metagross or Garchomp. Leave with U-turn to bring Fake Out back later.
Mega Metagross is the closer. Keep it healthy, and bring it in when its Fire, Ground, Dark and Ghost threats are weak or gone.
Against Trick Room, use Protect on both sides to use up its turns, then attack.
cautions: Tyranitar's sand damages Volcarona, Rillaboom and Primarina. Don't bring it just for the numbers.
Grassy Terrain halves Earthquake and Bulldoze only. Stomping Tantrum and High Horsepower still do full damage.
With Ice Punch, Metagross has no strong hit on Fairies. Wear them down, or let Volcarona use Heat Wave.
There is no Intimidate, and Haze is the only answer to boosts.

roles.Metagross: Mega attacker and closer. Psychic Fangs for Fighting types, Ice Punch for Dragons, Stomping Tantrum for Fire and Steel.
roles.Rillaboom: Fake Out, Grassy Glide priority and terrain. U-turn to pivot.
roles.Garchomp: Fast Ground attacker. Rock Slide for Flying types and Charizard.
roles.Volcarona: Tailwind and Rage Powder. Flame Body and Rocky Helmet punish contact.
roles.Tyranitar: Removes sun and rain with sand. Rock Slide and Knock Off.
roles.Primarina: Spread Water damage and Moonblast. Immune to Dragon; Haze removes boosts.
roles.Basculegion: Late-game cleaner with Last Respects. Aqua Jet finishes weak targets.

archetypes.Sun: Bring Tyranitar or Garchomp for Rock Slide on Charizard, and keep Metagross away from Heat Wave.
archetypes.Rain: Rillaboom takes Water well and hits it with Grassy Glide. Tyranitar changes the weather.
archetypes.Sand: Grassy Glide and Primarina's Water moves punish Ground and Rock types.
archetypes.Snow / Aurora Veil: Break the setter before Aurora Veil goes up: Fake Out it or target it on turn 1.
archetypes.Trick Room: Hit the setter on turn 1. If Trick Room goes up, use Protect to use up its turns.
archetypes.Psychic Terrain: Fake Out and Grassy Glide fail in Psychic Terrain. Switch Rillaboom in later to replace it with Grassy Terrain.
archetypes.Tailwind offense: Match Tailwind with Volcarona, and use Protect to use up theirs.
archetypes.Redirection + setup: Spread moves (Heat Wave, Hyper Voice, Rock Slide) ignore redirection. Haze removes the boosts.
archetypes.Fake Out balance: Intimidate and Fake Out slow you down. Lead with special damage from Primarina and Volcarona.
archetypes.Screens: Pressure Grimmsnarl early. It leaves with Parting Shot, so attack the partner.
archetypes.Mega Flying Tailwind: Ice Punch and Rock Slide. Keep Rillaboom away from Flying moves.
archetypes.Raichu offense: Stomping Tantrum from Garchomp and Metagross. Garchomp is immune to Electric, and Rillaboom resists it.
archetypes.Metagross mirror: Garchomp and Volcarona beat Metagross. Watch for its Ice Punch.
